They do not, in my judgment, defeat this qualified human-witness and finite-expression basis: the whole attribution is explicit, independent1960 corroborates the petition, the emendation is bounded and disclosed, and the actual new content is confined to an ordinary biographical virtue within the old complete prayer. No general permission for source-critical guesswork or historical name replacement is inferred.
